The '''A-wing Slash''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] maneuver invented by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Characteristics==
The A-wing Slash incorporated two groups of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] directed by a base vessel, usually a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. The first group of fighters, typically [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], moved to engage enemy fighters, but were then directed to alter course away from the incoming craft. As the X-wings veered off, the incoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighters moved to intercept their course, allowing the second element, typically a unit of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] to attack the enemy vessels. The A-wings tore into the enemy flank at full speed, slashing through their formation.<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The tactic confused the enemy starfighters, allowing the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces an advantage in combat. With the Imperial ships committed to following the X-wing group, they were easy targets for the superior speed and firepower of the A-wings. Once the A-wing pass had been completed, the X-wing group would then turn and finish off any enemy fighters since active. The A-wing Slash was best deployed against the fighter sentry line of an enemy capital ship. If the enemy fighters ignored the incoming A-wings, the A-wings could instead target the capital ship.<ref name="TLCSB" />

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Qat_Chrystac.jpg|thumb|right|A-wings performing the first A-wing Slash during the Battle of Qat Chrystac.]]
During the [[Battle of Qat Chrystac]]<ref name="TLC" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] first employed the tactic. With [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces outmaneuvered during the engagement, General Bel Iblis used the tactic to relieve enemy pressure on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Orthavan]]''.<ref name="TLC" />

During the [[Battle of Pesitiin]], Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] used it against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attackers masquerading as Bel Iblis, in the final days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Pellaeon was attempting to arrange peace talks, and by using the maneuver successfully with [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] in the role of the X-wings, and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] in place of the A-wings, he confirmed his attacker was not Bel Iblis, whom Pellaeon knew would never be fooled by his own maneuver. This observation allowed the peace talks to proceed and to eventually end the war between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="SOTP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
